convention: Every image is authored UPRIGHT (row 0 = top). All UVs below are v-up (v = 0 at the image bottom), the values the GLB stores (perfume_profile.py) and what shader-computed planar UVs produce. Load with THREE.TextureLoader and keep the default flipY = true.

T_PB_glass.png.R: satin band: 1 for inset distance in [0.45, 1.15] cm from the truncated arch outline (no neck)
T_PB_glass.png.G: dry-time: 0.65(1-v) - 0.3·halo(stud, r 0.45 cm) + noise ±0.05, clamped [0,1] (low = dries first)
T_PB_glass.png.B: cavity behind: 1 inside the cavity contour (inset 0.50, floor 1.20, top 8.25, corners r 0.40)
T_PB_glass.png.A: facet band: 1 for inset < 0.45 cm (the 40° table facet) and everywhere outside the silhouette
T_PB_glass.png.note: RGB carries data where A = 0: upload un-premultiplied (TextureLoader / ImageBitmap premultiplyAlpha "none"), never through a 2D canvas.
T_PB_glass.png.studs: perfume_meta.json studs if present, else perfume_profile.stud_positions()

T_PB_rosette.png.uv: same planar frame as glass UV0 (u=(x+0.035)/0.070, v=y/0.090): sample at the planar UV of the exit point
T_PB_rosette.png.content: 12-point girih rosette Ø3.6 cm centred (0, 4.6) cm, etched lines 0.06 cm (1 = etched)

T_PB_gold_n.png.normalSpace: tangent, OpenGL (+G = +v up), as three.js expects
T_PB_gold_n.png.boss: Cassandre monogram from public/lovenude.glb LNB_Cassandre (cylindrical unwrap → ortho height → normal), raised polished relief, height = 0.78 × boss Ø; disc Ø1.20 fills the tile
T_PB_gold_n.png.capTop: brushed sunburst on the table + 40° bevel (octagon half-flat ≤ 1.150 cm), polished chamfer; tile spans ±1.5153 cm
T_PB_gold_n.png.capSides: engraved border line (V groove 0.035 cm, inset 0.12 cm, corner r 0.06) in each facet tile; facet 1.160 × 2.598 cm (perfume_profile.CAP_FACET_TOP - CAP_Y0)
T_PB_gold_n.png.studs: hammered nail-head (overlapping dimples), unit dome disc fills the tile

T_PB_petals.png.alpha: straight; shape coverage (alphaTest 0.4 friendly), RGB extended under alpha 0
T_PB_petals.png.petalFrame: petals are centred on their cell u-centre, base at v = 0.04, tip at v = 0.96 of the cell; petal half-width ≤ 0.23 (néroli) / 0.155 (nymphéa) × petal length

colours.neroli: waxy white #F9F6ED, yellow-green base #CCDB8C, faint translucent veins
colours.nymphea: base #EAF0FF → tip #5A7BFF, fine deeper-blue veins, pale midrib
colours.stamens: #E8B84A filaments, #FAD66B anthers; néroli heart: green pistil, white filaments, yellow anthers

T_PB_sillage.png.alpha: straight; alpha = intensity/coverage, 0 at every tile border
T_PB_sillage.png.pointCoordNote: gl_PointCoord has y down: tile (u0,v0,u1,v1) → uv = vec2(u0 + pc.x*(u1-u0), v1 - pc.y*(v1-v0))

door_mask_256.png.content: 1 inside the door hole (identical to Portal_Occluder in mj_door.glb), same UV as the poster

door_arch_path.json.points: 96 × [x, y], printed arch, left springing → apex → right springing
